text:
Sorry about your string of pearls. You're within the 90-day guarantee that comes with Leafy Plus (about 5 weeks in), but the policy I have doesn't say what the guarantee covers or whether damage from overwatering is eligible, so I can't promise a replacement or refund. I can escalate this to a Support Lead to review, and if you'd like that, tell me and include your order number.

If you want to try to save the plant, our Plant Care Specialists are on chat 9am-5pm Mon-Fri (your local time), so you could reach them from Monday. You can also email help@leafy.example and expect a reply within 1 business day.
